title: The process lock folder follows the OS user and HOME, so two bots on one wallet under different users or a changed HOME each get their own lock
severity_rationale: S3, equal to the estimate: the exclusion needs a second bot started under another OS user or a changed HOME, which is a deliberate unusual act; the header documents it.

evidence.note: the lock directory is derived from the OS user home folder

sibling_sites_checked: Lock file path comes only from defaultLockDir and the wallet address. Nothing else relocates the lock (no env var or flag, by design).
recommendation: Phase 24 decides on a machine-wide lock location. Documented in src/utils/processLock.ts.
